Thanks Sarah — got the request and the attachment. Short answers up front: yes, we can support a 12-month committed block with a +25% capacity uplift; procurement portal onboarding + PO flow is required for billing updates; and we only need an updated W-9 and an acceptance of our standard order form (I've attached a redlined SOW for the expanded capacity).

Next steps I propose:
- Triage docs: we (tessa + jonas) will confirm the SOW + billing cadence today and upload to the portal.
- Proc portal invite: Tessa will send the Acme portal invite and onboarding checklist (SOC2 evidence, contact list, billing contact).
- PO & terms: Priyom will capture the PO# and confirm the committed quantity/date for invoicing.

Triage notes: the billing team prefers PO -> portal -> invoice (net 30). If Acme needs net 45/60 we can route to finance for an exception. Also, for the term change we need the signature on the updated SOW (DocuSign link to follow).

I've attached: SOW_Redwood_v2.docx (redline).
